gloss: a glance; at first sight; public eye

examples.japanese: {一目|ひとめ}{見|み}て{気|き}に{入|い}った。
examples.english: I liked it the moment I saw it.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}に{一目|ひとめ}{惚|ぼ}れした。
examples.english: I fell in love with her at first sight.
To care about what people think.

examples.japanese: {一目|ひとめ}を{避|さ}けて{会|あ}った。
examples.english: We met out of the public eye.

examples.japanese: {一目|ひとめ}のある{場所|ばしょ}では{話|はな}しにくい。
examples.english: It's hard to talk in a place where people might see us.

notes:
{一目|ひとめ} has three main uses: a brief look, instant recognition, and being seen by others.

PRONUNCIATION:
Also read as いちもく in the compound {一目|いちもく}{瞭然|りょうぜん} (perfectly clear at a glance).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {一目|ひとめ}{惚|ぼ}れ: love at first sight
- {一目|ひとめ}{置|お}く: to hold someone in respect/esteem
- {一目|ひとめ}{散|さん}に{逃|に}げる: to flee at full speed
- {一目|ひとめ}で{分|わ}かる: to understand at a glance
- {一目|ひとめ}を{気|き}にする: to worry about what people think
- {一目|ひとめ}を{避|さ}ける: to avoid public attention

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一目|ひとめ}: one glance (brief, instant)
- {一見|いっけん}: at first glance / apparently (implies a superficial impression that may be wrong)
